Kresilo
STUDIO
INTERACTIVE PROTOTYPE
Culture feeds creativity.
Creativity produces culture.

Kresilo is a design workspace that treats references, proposals and decisions as one continuous record. This prototype explores creative continuity: gather with a reason, review a proposed direction, approve it, and keep the decision. Deterministic guidance is labelled truthfully — no external AI runs here.

From a reference you love to a decision you can keep.
THE WORKFLOW
01
Gather a reference, with a reason

Pick a Salt Flats study tile and say why it matters. The reason is saved with the reference, not lost in a folder.

02
Review a proposed direction

Deterministic prototype guidance suggests a direction and cites the saved references and reasons it used. Nothing is applied yet.

03
Approve it — or decline

Approving changes the poster and records the decision. Declining leaves the artwork untouched.

04
Keep the decision

The decision, its sources, and a new version stay with the project, so the work remains explainable later.

SALT FLATS · ORIGINAL KRESILO DESIGN STUDY / FAITHFUL EDITABLE RECREATION
The references are the memory.

Every reference carries a source and a reason. Prototype guidance reads those reasons, cites the references it used, and returns a patch on a card — it never repaints the poster on its own.

01
Gather

References and their reasons live inside the project — the culture that feeds the work.

02
Propose

Guidance returns a patch, a rationale and its citations. Nothing is applied without you.

03
Approve

Approving writes the poster change, the decision, a new version, and a history entry together. That record is the culture produced.

No external model, image service or credit is called. Prototype guidance is rule-based and local.
